ἐν-τευξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐντυγχάνω, which see), [in LXX: 2Ma.4.3 * ;] 
__1. a lighting upon, meeting with. 
__2. conversation. 
__3. a petition (in this sense common in π.; cf. Deiss., BS, 121 f., 146; MM, Exp., iii): 1Ti.4.5 p1., 1Ti.2.1.†
SYN.: δέησις (which see) (AS)

(τίκτω), [in LXX for נֶשֶׁךְ, etc. ;] 
__(a) a bringing forth, birth; 
__(b) offspring. Metaphorical, of the produce of money lent out, interest, usury (cf. Merch. of Venice, I, iii, "a breed of barren metal "): Mat.25.27, Luk.19.23 (Soph., Plat., al.).†
(AS)
